name: Ambassador Laquatus
title: The Otarian Intriguer
summary: An ambitious merfolk ambassador who pursued the Mirari through alliances, manipulations, and opportunism.
biography: Laquatus represented the merfolk court but devoted considerable effort to advancing his own position in Otaria's shifting conflicts.
The Mirari offered leverage over the emperor, the Cabal, the Order, and other contenders. Laquatus pursued it through political intrigue rather than the straightforward combat favored by Kamahl.
His continuing attempts to seize its power contributed to the conflicts that brought Kamahl to his final decision in Krosa.

featuredCard.name: Laquatus's Creativity
featuredCard.significance: A named Odyssey-era reference to Laquatus; not a direct portrait of his attempt to acquire the Mirari.

source.title: Wizards of the Coast — Dominarian Cartography
